description: This Java class 'CopyTable2DWorker' extends SwingWorker to perform background copying of a 2D table's contents to the system clipboard, and manages cursor states during its operation.

classes.name: CopyTable2DWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker subclass that processes a Table2D object to extract its data and copy it to the system clipboard asynchronously, while managing UI cursors.

methods.name: CopyTable2DWorker
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the worker with a specific Table2D instance.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Performs the background task of retrieving table header and data, concatenating them, and copying the result to the system clipboard.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Resets the cursor states of associated windows and the table upon completion of the background task.
